newsitem.title: USA: InControl sets $15.3 mln stock placement.
newsitem.headline: InControl sets $15.3 mln stock placement.

text.p: InControl Inc Thursday completed the private placement of $15.3 million of common stock to a group of European and U.S institutional investors.
"These funds strengthen our balance sheet at a time when we have achieved significant developmental milestones," said Kurt Wheeler, chief executive officer.
In a statement, InControl said it agreed to register the shares under the Securities Act of 1933. The registration is intended to be effective before the end of September.
